910103 and 910107 are not the same estimand. 910103 is the rental value of the whole property; 910107 is the share of it this consumer unit owns. quality_scale_definition.HIGH: Relative standard error below 10 percent, variance estimator non-degenerate.
quality_scale_definition.LOW: Relative standard error at least 25 percent, variance estimator non-degenerate. The point estimate is real but wide; it may be carried with its interval and may not be quoted bare.
quality_scale_definition.MODERATE: Relative standard error at least 10 and below 25 percent, variance estimator non-degenerate.
quality_scale_definition.UNUSABLE: Either the cell has no records at all, or the variance estimator is degenerate on it. No figure is offered.

usability_definitions.BENCHMARKED: The CE annual weighting and income-quintile procedure has been implemented and shown to reproduce published LABSTAT aggregates for this UCC's concept, so an aggregate derived for it can be defended.
usability_definitions.NOT_ESTABLISHED: No validated aggregation procedure exists for this UCC. Observing records is not the same as being able to weight them.
